questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "turnover" mean?
options: The amount of cash a company holds in its bank account
The number of companies listed on the exchange
The profit earned by a single company
The total value of all shares traded during the day
questions.explain_en: Turnover refers to the total trading volume, i.e., the total value of shares bought and sold that day.
questions.explain_zh: 「turnover」指的是當天所有成交的總金額，也就是交易量的總值。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan stocks close above 46,300 as turnover tops NT$1 trillion

questions.question: What was the TAIEX closing level on September 28?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the index closed at 46,331 on that date.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明指數在 9 月 28 日收於 46,331 點。
questions.news_title_en: Taiwan stocks close above 46,300 as turnover tops NT$1 trillion

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word “capacity” mean?
options: The amount of production ability a factory has
The total amount of money a company owns
The physical size of a building
The number of employees working at a company
questions.explain_en: Here “capacity” refers to how much chip production TSMC can do, not money or people.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「capacity」指的是台積電的生產能力，而非金錢或員工數量。
questions.news_title_en: TSMC's AI revenue seen topping US$100bn as advanced-node demand booms

questions.question: According to the article, AI server processors could exceed what percentage of TSMC's revenue by 2028?
questions.explain_en: The summary states AI server processors could exceed 20% of revenue by 2028.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到 AI 伺服器處理器的營收佔比可能在 2028 年超過 20%。
questions.news_title_en: TSMC's AI revenue seen topping US$100bn as advanced-node demand booms

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "relief" mean?
options: A reduction or easing of a burden
questions.explain_en: Here "relief" refers to a reduction or easing of the capital requirement burden for the companies.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「relief」指的是減輕資本要求的負擔。
questions.news_title_en: FSC eases capital rules for financial holdings ahead of new solvency regime

questions.question: How many insurance-type holding companies may defer their CAR filing by a month?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that 11 insurance-type holdcos may defer their CAR filing by a month.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到有 11 家保險類控股公司可以將 CAR 申報延期一個月。
questions.news_title_en: FSC eases capital rules for financial holdings ahead of new solvency regime

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "allocation" mean?
options: The risk level of an investment
The legal ownership of a property
questions.explain_en: Here "allocation" refers to how the clients divide or distribute their money into offshore assets.
questions.explain_zh: 此處的「allocation」指的是客戶如何把資金分配到離岸資產上。
questions.news_title_en: Ultra-rich Taiwanese pile into offshore assets, CTBC-BCG study finds

questions.question: According to the report, what percentage of ultra‑high‑net‑worth Taiwanese clients hold overseas assets?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that 86% of such clients have offshore assets.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明有 86% 的超高淨值客戶持有離岸資產。
questions.news_title_en: Ultra-rich Taiwanese pile into offshore assets, CTBC-BCG study finds

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "exempted" mean?
questions.explain_en: "Exempted" means the items are not included in the taxable estate, so they are removed from tax calculation.
questions.explain_zh: 「exempted」表示這些項目不列入課稅遺產，亦即從稅額計算中剔除。
questions.news_title_en: 2026 estate and gift tax thresholds set the year's wealth-transfer planning

questions.question: According to the summary, what is the maximum value of everyday household items that can be excluded from the taxable estate in 2026?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that everyday household items worth up to NT$1 million are excluded.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明，價值最高可達新台幣100萬元的日常家用品可免稅。
questions.news_title_en: 2026 estate and gift tax thresholds set the year's wealth-transfer planning

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "hawkish" mean?
questions.explain_en: "Hawkish" describes a stance that prefers raising interest rates to combat inflation.
questions.explain_zh: 「鷹派」指的是傾向提高利率以抑制通膨的立場。
questions.news_title_en: CBC seen holding rates as inflation stays above 2%

questions.question: What was the August CPI rate mentioned in the summary?
questions.explain_en: The summary states that August CPI rose to 2.04%.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到八月份的消費者物價指數上升至 2.04%。
questions.news_title_en: CBC seen holding rates as inflation stays above 2%
